title: Ridge to Sea: A Two-Night Peninsula Escape
dek: Start in Red Hill wine country, finish at the southern tip, and let the weekend widen as it goes.

bookingChecklist.item: First night at Jackalope and second night at Hotel Sorrento
Check the Red Hill Market date

stops.note: Arrive through the sculpture park and let lunch set the pace for the whole weekend.
Check in on the ridge and commit to the theatrical version of the Peninsula for night one.
If the market is on, start here. If not, use the hour for a slower breakfast and village loop.
Keep lunch lighter today. Polperro Restaurant and Cellar Door are closed on Mondays and Tuesdays; check service times and book lunch before setting your itinerary.
Swap the wine rhythm for ocean air before the second night.
Sleep at the tip with a bay-view drink before dinner downstairs or nearby.
Finish with the long view over the Heads before heading back to Melbourne.

editorNote: Start with lunch and a night on the ridge, then move south for the coast and a second night in Sorrento. Each day changes register: vineyards first, a coastal walk next, Point Nepean to finish. Book the two stays and lunches before arranging the rest. Day two has the most moving parts, so treat the market as optional and leave the coastal walk out if lunch runs long.
